Two independent readers (strongest model) agreed on word division and on page/plate/line/rubric throughout; they differed in the signs or transliteration of 94 words. 31 of those were settled by house rulings: A1 for the 1st-person suffix and Ani's determinative, and Aa11 in mꜣꜥ. Firing's own corrections: in χeri (p. 193, l. 22) the top sign is T28 (ẖr), not S26 or W11; in t'eṭet-à (pp. 189, 191) the first sign is printed as a plain rod, coded U28 approx (ḏ). Approx: U28 ×2, A40 (Shu with a plume), O34 (t'at'at), O36 (Per-ṭep-ṭu-f), U38 (māχa-k). 52 words carry "unsure". Rubrics: l. 1 title, and each "t'eṭ àn" (l. 1, 17, 20). Restored: àn (l. 3), the strokes of ḥeri (l. 22). Skipped: the rows above PLATE XXX on p. 189 (ani-175) and the p. 193 Appendix (Naville Bl. 133) with its footnote. The readers' files are in drafts/ani-125-introduction/readers/. No Sonnet roles (establishing is plate reading).
